objective: The health-history since parameter bounds snapshots as well as cleared alerts, matching the OpenAPI description and stopping a far-future since from returning everything.
decision_supported: Does since filter only alerts? No: the documented parameter filters both, and the test that asserted the full set codified the defect.
acceptance: since=BASE+2 over four snapshots returns the last two.
A far-future since returns no snapshots.
Cleared alerts remain filtered by the same parameter.
stop_conditions: The change would need an API schema change.
risks_and_fallbacks: A consumer relying on the unfiltered set would see fewer rows; that is what the parameter promised.
